population.admission: one random-tie-expected pooled-global top-k book across sides and timestamps after each score's own causal recent-EV map

purge.inner: last chronological 25% of legal outer training timestamps; fit labels resolve strictly before inner validation start
purge.april: all HPO and PVC selection use only labels resolved before 2025-04-01T00:00:00Z

feature_contract.interaction_rule: standardize each transition on the legal fold/side training rows, multiply by base_oof_score and clip to [-1,1]
forbidden: timing, MAE, target-price, wait or reprice fields

H0_controls.rule: reuse sealed scores and remap identically; no refit

heads.opportunity: P(cost-aware pre-exit opportunity) on all rows
heads.gain_given_success: positive net magnitude | successful deployed trailing
heads.payoff_given_opportunity_failure: signed exact net | opportunity AND not successful trailing

H2_deployed_outcome_multiclass.payoff: one conditional signed exact-net regressor per class
H2_deployed_outcome_multiclass.combination: sum over class probability times class-conditional signed net payoff

H3_deployed_outcome_hierarchical.second_stage: three-class trailing_nonpositive / hard_adverse / timeout conditional on not successful trailing
H3_deployed_outcome_hierarchical.payoff: one conditional signed exact-net regressor for success and each non-success class
H3_deployed_outcome_hierarchical.combination: p_success * success_payoff + (1-p_success) * sum conditional risk-class probability times conditional payoff

H4_severe_loss_hurdle.nonsevere_payoff: signed exact-net regressor conditional on not severe

unsupported_target_rule.target_deployed_other_adverse_exit_attri: FORBIDDEN as a standalone side-local probability head; merge only through target_deployed_hard_adverse
unsupported_target_rule.reason: zero March short events and inadequate March long support

catboost_hpo.classifier_selection: minimum inner log loss, then Brier, then shallower geometry
catboost_hpo.multiclass_selection: minimum inner multiclass log loss, then shallower geometry
catboost_hpo.regressor_selection: minimum inner MAE, then maximum rank IC, then shallower geometry

feature_selection.method: fold/side/head-local CatBoost PredictionValuesChange on the winning inner model
feature_selection.rule: positive importance, cumulative 90%, minimum 8, maximum 24, force the four score anchors

mapping.primary: current separate score-specific daily 21-day pooled isotonic anchor plus shrunk-side residual
mapping.selection: architecture selection always uses the primary mapper; alternative mapping research remains a separate no-retrain artifact
mapping.causality: only labels resolved and scores available strictly before each daily snapshot

selection.tie_break: fewer selected features, shallower mean geometry, lexical name

economics: raw and causally mapped pooled-global top 1/5/10/20 gross/cost/net
April aggregate and latest seven decision days
cutoff tie population and selected share
side, asset, frozen regime and realised-exit attribution from the one global book

promotion_gates: March aggregate, latest and worst-fold mapped top10 > 0
April reused diagnostic aggregate and latest-seven-day mapped top10 > 0
aggregate and every selection-fold cutoff tie selected share <= 5%
better than identically mapped residual and A5 controls
new untouched forward evidence remains required
portfolio_replay: forbidden until every promotion gate passes on new untouched forward evidence
